title: GradCO: Behavior-Aware Gradient-Conflict Offloading for Text-Based Person Anomaly Search
abstract: arXiv:2610.37267v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-based Person Anomaly Search (TPAS) retrieves a target pedestrian using natural-language descriptions of appearance and normal or anomalous behavior. Unlike conventional text-based person retrieval, TPAS must preserve identity cues while distinguishing fine-grained behaviors. It presents two challenges: same-identity, different-behavior hard negatives cause gradient conflict during granular alignment, while strong appearance cues can obscure weak behavioral evidence during aggregation. We propose GradCO (behavior-aware Gradient-Conflict Offloading), comprising three complementary components. Behavior-Aware Mixture-of-Experts (B-MoE) forms appearance, normal-behavior, and anomalous-behavior streams whose roles are learned from retrieval objectives without expert-specific semantic labels. translated_title: GradCO：面向基于文本行人异常搜索的行为感知梯度冲突卸载方法
translated_abstract: 基于文本的行人异常搜索（TPAS）利用自然语言描述中关于外观以及正常或异常行为的信息来检索目标行人。与传统的基于文本的行人检索不同，TPAS 必须在保留身份线索的同时区分细粒度行为。这带来了两个挑战：同身份、不同行为的困难负样本在细粒度对齐过程中会引起梯度冲突，而强烈的外观线索在聚合过程中可能掩盖微弱的行为证据。我们提出了 GradCO（行为感知梯度冲突卸载方法），由三个互补组件构成。行为感知混合专家（B-MoE）构建了外观、正常行为和异常行为三个流，其角色从检索目标中学习得到，无需专家特定的语义标签。冲突卸载学习（COL）在相似度计算中使用基于样本对条件的卸载锚点，以减轻主网络上的冲突梯度负担……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 GradCO 框架，通过行为感知混合专家（B-MoE）与冲突卸载学习（COL）等组件，解决文本行人异常搜索中同身份不同行为困难负样本导致的梯度冲突以及外观线索掩盖微弱行为证据的问题。
en_tdlr: GradCO proposes a behavior-aware gradient-conflict offloading framework that addresses gradient conflicts caused by same-identity hard negatives and the masking of weak behavioral evidence by strong appearance cues in text-based person anomaly search.
